Heating the bird bath

Which heater should we use?

The bath froze eleven mornings last winter. Both heaters would keep it usable, but the cable takes more work to fit around the basin.

Requirement Immersion heater Heated cable
Installation Drop into the water. Wrap around the basin.
Maintenance Lift out to clean. Leave fitted while cleaning.
When spring arrives Store indoors. Disconnect the power.
Fit an immersion heater

This is the simpler installation. It drops into the water and can be lifted out for cleaning or stored indoors when spring arrives.

Wrap a heated cable around the basin

The cable can stay in place through the year. It takes more work to fit but keeps the basin clear for the birds.
